up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1862 (Tyrosine-protein kinase ABL1). Only include rows where standard_relation is exactly '=' and pchembl_value is not null. For each such activity, provide the assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type, which will be 'IC50'), and pchembl_value (from activities.pchembl_value). The data must come from joining activities to assays (on assay_id), assays to target_dictionary (on tid) with target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1862', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', and organism = 'Homo sapiens', and activities to molecule_dictionary (on molregno) and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (on molregno). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1862'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
